title: PII entity-vs-person screen (aggregate/entity-level only; redact private individuals)
context: Public contracts data can name natural persons — sole proprietors, named officials — alongside business entities. Open-Spending-Explainers surfaces entity-level and aggregate facts only; personal data of private individuals (personal addresses, personal identifiers) must be redacted or withheld, not published. The PII entity-vs-person classifier is a privacy safeguard that must be in place before any contracts data is processed. Depends on schema-005 (data model defining supplierIsEntity).
objective: Implement the PII entity-vs-person screen (lib/pii) that classifies contract parties as entity or natural person, defaults to surfacing entity/aggregate-level data only, and redacts or withholds personal data of private individuals (personal addresses, personal identifiers) before any contracts data flows downstream.
acceptanceCriteria: Classifies each contract party as entity or natural person (the supplierIsEntity flag in the Contract data model) based on the source record
Default output surfaces entity-level or aggregate-level data only; personal data of private individuals (personal address, personal identifiers) is redacted or withheld before downstream use
No profiling, no targeting, and no voter-data linkage in any output
Tested on fixtures including sole-proprietor rows, named officials, and entity parties across the expected data formats
PR merged with green CI and maintainer review passed
output: A merged PR containing the PII entity-vs-person classifier (lib/pii) that enforces aggregate/entity-level-only output and redacts private-individual personal data from contracts before downstream processing.
